description: Load BEFORE writing or changing anything a DatoCMS plugin renders, in any project whose package.json (read it first) lists `datocms-plugin-sdk`, even when the request never mentions DatoCMS and even for a small tweak: the interface of a config screen, field editor or addon, field-extension config, sidebar or sidebar panel, custom page, modal, inspector, outlet or asset source. Built with datocms-react-ui 4, the dashboard's own components, by the rules of react-ui.datocms.com. Use for a new surface (with `datocms-plugin`, which wires its hook), restyling to look native, UI review, picking and composing components (Canvas, Page, Pane, Toolbar, FieldWrapper, Table, Dropdown, BlankSlate, Modal), colour tokens and dark mode, frame height and what the host already draws (a title, border or close button shown twice), list-and-detail and form screens, keyboard actions, upgrading from datocms-react-ui 2.x or 3.x. Plugin work with no UI (hooks, ctx, lifecycle, scaffolding, permissions, publishing): `datocms-plugin`.
